==English== ===Etymology=== {{root|en|ine-pro|*h₁es-}} From {{inh|en|enm|possible}}, from {{der|en|fro|possible}}, from {{der|en|la|possibilis||possible}}, from {{m|la|possum|posse, possum|to be able}}; see [[power]]. Displaced {{ncog|enm|acumendlic|t=possible}}, from {{ncog|ang|ācumendlīċ|t=possible}}. Compare also {{ncog|ang|mihtelīċ|t=strong, capable, powerful, possible}}, which was cognate with {{ncog|goh|mahtlīh|t=possible}} and {{ncog|non|máttulígr|t=mighty, possible}}. Compare also {{ncog|nl|mogelijk||possible}} and {{ncog|de|möglich||possible}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/ˈpɒs.ɪ.bl̩/|[ˈpɒs.ɪ.bɫ̩]|a=RP}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈpɒs.ɪ.bl̩/|[ˈpɒs.ɪ.bɫ̩]|/ˈpɒs.ə.bəl/|[ˈpɒs.ə.bɫ̩]|a=SSB}} ** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Back ache-possible.wav|a=London}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈpɑ.sə.bəl/|[ˈpɑ.sə.bɫ̩]|a=GenAm,Atlantic Canada}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-possible.ogg|a=California}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈpɒs.ə.bəl/|[ˈpɒs.ə.bɫ̩]|a=CA,Boston,Maine}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈpɔs.ə.bəl/|[ˈpɔs.ə.bɫ̩]|a=AU}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈpɒs.ə.bəl/|[ˈpɔ̟s.ə.bɫ̩]|a=NZ|q2=cultivated}} * {{hyphenation|en|pos|si|ble}} ===Adjective=== {{en-adj|more}} # {{lb|en|usually|not comparable}} [[able|Able]] but not [[certain]] to happen; neither [[inevitable]] nor [[impossible]]. #: {{syn|en|futurable|Thesaurus:possible}} #: {{ant|en|certain|inevitable|impossible}} #: {{ux|en|Rain tomorrow is '''possible''', but I wouldn't bet on it.}} #: {{ux|en|It's not just '''possible''', it's probable that there will be rain tomorrow.}} #* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=8|passage=The humor of my proposition appealed more strongly to Miss Trevor than I had looked for, and from that time forward she became her old self again;{{...}}. Now she had come to look upon the matter in its true proportions, and her anticipation of a '''possible''' chance of teaching him a lesson was a pleasure to behold.}} # {{lb|en|comparable}} Capable of being done or achieved; [[feasible]]. #: {{syn|en|achievable|doable|viable}} #: {{ant|en|impossible}} #: {{ux|en|It's '''possible''' for anyone to learn to play the bagpipes.}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=1901|author=Louis Freeland Smith|title=The Public|volume=4|page=438|pageurl=http://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=inu.30000080738168&page=search;seq=444;view=image;num=438 |passage=And success in minor degree, in the sense in which he uses the term "success," is only somewhat more '''possible''' than success in winning the White House chair.}} #* {{RQ:Economist|date=2013-06-29|volume=407|issue=8842|page=72–3 |title=[http://www.economist.com/news/international/science-and-technology/21580133-how-microbes-promote-liver-cancer-overweight-punch-gut A punch in the gut] |passage=Mostly, the microbiome is beneficial. It helps with digestion and enables people to extract a lot more calories from their food than would otherwise be '''possible'''. Research over the past few years, however, has implicated it in diseases from atherosclerosis to asthma to autism.}} # Being [[considered]], e.g. for a [[position]]. #: {{ux|en|Jones and Smith are both '''possible''' for the opening in sales.}} # Apparently valid, likely, [[plausible]]. #: {{syn|en|likely|plausible}} #: {{ant|en|implausible}} ====Derived terms==== {{col|en|compossible|counterpossible|nonpossible|possibilist|possibleness|unpossible |as much as possible|as quickly as possible|as soon as possible|humanly possible|if possible|possible world|ASAP|possibly|art of the possible|anything is possible}} ====Related terms==== {{col|en |possibility |potent |potential |probable |improbable |incidental |contingent }} ====Translations==== {{trans-top|able but not certain to happen}} * Albanian: * Arabic: * Armenian: * Asturian: * Azerbaijani: * Belarusian: * Bulgarian: * Burmese: * Carpathian Rusyn: * Catalan: * Chinese: * Czech: * Danish: * Dutch: * Esperanto: * Estonian: * Faroese: * Fijian: * Finnish: * French: * Galician: * Georgian: * German: * Greek: * Hawaiian: * Hebrew: * Hindi: * Hungarian: * Icelandic: * Interlingua: * Isan: * Italian: * Japanese: * Kashubian: * Kazakh: * Khmer: * Korean: * Lao: * Latin: * Latvian: * Lithuanian: * Livonian: * Lü: * Luxembourgish: * Macedonian: * Malagasy: * Maltese: * Māori: * Mongolian: * Nepali: * Norman: * Old English: * Persian: * Polish: * Portuguese: * Romanian: * Russian: {{t+|ru|возмо́жный}}, {{t+|ru|вероя́тный}} {{qualifier|probable}} * Sami: * Serbo-Croatian: * Shan: * Slovak: * Slovene: * Sorbian: * Spanish: * Swedish: * Tagalog: * Tajik: * Thai: * Turkish: * Ukrainian: * Urdu: * Uzbek: * Vietnamese: * Volapük: * Walloon: * Welsh: * Yaghnobi: * Yiddish: * Zhuang: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|capable of being done or achieved;
